description: ATS UAQ Math & Robotics Team is building Mission Architect, a browser-based spacecraft-design game using real orbital mechanics (the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation) for the Space Mission Design Game challenge. Our team of 5 Grade 12 students, mentored by teachers Ahmed El Deeb and Bahaa Saleh, brings coding, bilingual EN/AR design, and a shared love of the UAE's space program (Hope probe, Rashid rover, Hazza Al Mansouri) to this build.
